description: Change an existing discount on the merchant's Shopify store (create_shopify_discount_code makes one; list_shopify_discount_codes lists them). Name it by id or code. action get, codes (the codes it has), update (title, code, percentOff or amountOff, minSubtotal or minQuantity, startsAt, endsAt (null = no end), usageLimit, oncePerCustomer; amount-off and free-shipping codes), activate (switch an expired or paused code back on), deactivate, delete, add_codes (codes: up to 250 new unique codes on the same discount, e.g. one per influencer; each failure is named). Every change to a live code is a preview until confirm:true. Free.

code.description: find it by its code; update: the new code

name: manage_shopify_discounts
title: Edit Shopify discounts
